description: Dependency update pull requests for k8s-borg. CONTRIBUTING.md says what the bot updates and what stays manual; tests/renovate-config.bats guards both.

git-submodules.description: The borg-ui pin moves by hand: each move is a release with its CHANGELOG line.

helm-values.description: The chart's image tags move with the chart's releases.

helmv3.description: The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases.

customManagers.description: Version pins under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line; a *_DIGEST ARG right below the version is that image's digest.
Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.
Runner labels of a job matrix (build-image.yml): the github-actions manager reads runners in runs-on only.

packageRules.description: Release tags of the pinned downloads carry a v prefix, the pins do not.
PYTHON_VERSION follows borg-ui's runtime base (tests/python-version.bats) and moves with the borg-ui pin.
The custom manager bumps the MySQL image, version and digest together.
Images the local test stack builds itself.
The runner labels of a matrix go with the runs-on ones; a new major shares their branch by its name.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.
A new digest under the same version means a release tag was moved: approve it on the dashboard after a look at the commit.

prBodyNotes: This changes the agent image: add a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md before merging.
The build fails until `ETCD_SHA256_AMD64` and `ETCD_SHA256_ARM64` in docker/Dockerfile are the sums of https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/SHA256SUMS.

packageRules.description: The etcd client is tested against the etcd of k3s and of kubeadm: a new minor is a deliberate move.

prBodyNotes: The build fails until `RCLONE_SHA256_AMD64` and `RCLONE_SHA256_ARM64` in docker/rclone.env and docker/Dockerfile are the sums of https://downloads.rclone.org/v{{{newVersion}}}/SHA256SUMS, after its PGP signature checks out against the rclone release key FBF737ECE9F8AB18604BD2AC93935E02FF3B54FA.

packageRules.description: s3fs is built from the release with a patch (docker/s3fs/): every release is a deliberate move.
prBodyNotes: The s3fs-builder stage in docker/Dockerfile says when the patch and the stage go. Otherwise check that the patch still applies, and set `S3FS_SHA512` to the sum of https://github.com/s3fs-fuse/s3fs-fuse/archive/v{{{newVersion}}}.tar.gz; the build fails until it matches.

packageRules.description: A new major of an image pin or a base image waits for approval on the dashboard.
The documentation site's npm packages (site/), once a month; its pull requests build the site.
The local test stack (local/), once a month.
